format: y/YYYY.bin.gz = gzip of little-endian: char[4] "UD01", u16 nT, u16 nD, u16 tickerIdx[nT], u16 dayIdx[nD], u16 p[nD][nT] (p_up*10000, 65535=missing), i16 r[nD][nT] (o2c return in bp, -32768=missing)
notes: Research page, not a trading signal.

Every past day uses a walk-forward out-of-sample prediction: the model was trained only on earlier dates (purged by the horizon); features use only Yahoo bars before that day plus that day's official 09:30 open.
Dev period 2020-01-02..2026-07-02: yearly-retrained walk-forward, used to choose the model. FINAL HOLDOUT from 2026-07-06: scored once with the frozen model.
Prices: Yahoo split-adjusted, not dividend-adjusted. Universe: >=60 prior bars, prior close >= $1, 20-day mean dollar volume >= $1M.

Call = UP when p_up > 0.5. The base rate is below 50%, so most calls are DOWN; the within-day ranking (decile) is the more useful read. On the holdout the 0/1 hit rate does not beat always-down; AUC, log-loss and the decile spread do beat the baselines.
